description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counter(s) due to Renata.
When Scurry Oak enters, it triggers, creating a creature token that enters with +1/+1 counter(s) due to Renata.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters with +1/+1 counter(s) due to Renata.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.
